general.dl: 4+4 BS-MD (Zucker) app due early with admission
general.note: Easy admit with big merit; the 4+4 BS-MD with Zucker/Northwell is a separate, tiny, EC-weighted competition. Long Island location, Northwell hospital system access.
general.medNote: The base school is a safety; the BS-MD is not.
